Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1290
Claimant:
Ronald Bradford
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
5-19-25
The insured reported a rear-end collision at a slow-moving intersection, with the claimant's vehicle stopped in front.
The claimant is represented by counsel, and the file has been opened for bodily injury and property damage.
6-24-25
Photos taken at the scene confirm the general position of both vehicles and show that the damage is mostly in line
with the described impact. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the photos and the account given are
the main sources for now.
8-31-25
Police and witnesses at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. The driver of the insured
vehicle lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member under the policy.
11-17-25
The claimant reports a shoulder injury, and the kind and force of the crash appear to fit that injury well. No earlier
injury to the same body area is known, and the claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far.
11-21-25
Treatment has followed a usual course and has tapered off as the claimant improved. Nothing in the medical notes so
far suggests the course of care has been unusual.
12-7-25
No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. Counsel
has been informed that the claim is under ongoing review, and the file remains open pending the final medical
summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
